messages:
mira: Customer 'NordicApps' in DE submitted a resale certificate for reverse-charge but invoice is on hold. Their CSV/PDF upload shows 'file type not supported' and our parser returns 'corrupt content'. They also included a VAT ID like `DE-123456789` and VIES rejects it as invalid. PO# 4567 is attached to the order so billing can't finalize. Can someone triage?

brianna: looking. are they on a paid plan or trial? PO requirement shouldn't block exemption if manual review approved.

mira: paid monthly (Dedicated). Support portal shows upload timestamp as `2023-11-15T23:45:02+02:00` but the file metadata embedded in the PDF says `2023-11-15T21:45:02Z`. wondering if timezone/encoding mangled the file header so our converter flagged it.

leon: @brianna @mira i'll pull the raw upload blob and try to run it through `pdfinfo` + our OCR fallback. if the VAT id has `DE-` prefix we should strip non-numeric chars before calling VIES. quick check: can you paste the exact bytes or a small sample?

mira: pasted base64 snippet to the ticket (link). VAT string appears as `DE‑123456789` (note that dash is U+2011 non-breaking hyphen in their export). that could definitely fail our simple regex.

brianna: billing-bot tried auto-verify and failed, left note: "resale cert unreadable". Can we do manual acceptance so invoice isn't blocked? Customer says finance needs the credit now.

dmitri: legal: before manual acceptance confirm the cert contains legal entity name + VAT id + signature page. name on cert is "Nordic Apps AB" while invoice company name is "NordicApps GmbH" — possible entity mismatch. if they are different legal entities we cannot accept reverse charge for the billed entity.

leon: reproduction steps I ran locally: 1) download blob 2) run `iconv -f utf-8 -t utf-8 -c` to clean weird hyphens 3) normalize VAT to `/[A-Z]{2}\d+/` then call VIES. After normalizing `DE‑123456789` -> `DE123456789` VIES still returned "unknown id". could be older/expired VAT or VIES replication lag.

brianna: action items: (1) ask customer to confirm legal entity and provide alternate doc (bank statement or tax authority letter) (2) support to accept file manually only if entity matches and finance approves (3) escalate to tax team if VIES still says unknown after normalization.

mira: did manual accept flow and attached sanitized PDF to the billing ticket for review. set invoice on-hold flag with note: "awaiting finance sign-off for manual resale cert acceptance".

billing-bot: automated message: Invoice 2023-789 is on hold (reason: tax_evidence_pending). To release: attach approved evidence and remove PO hold or mark PO as fulfilled.

dmitri: once we have matching legal docs, i'm ok with manual accept but we should document the exception in case of audit. please CC compliance.

mira: thanks — i'll request the alternate docs from the customer and add compliance to the ticket. leaving thread open until VIES/finance resolved. :hourglass:
